title: 第13章 周末的修炼加餐
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周六早上七点，安槐被一阵急促的敲门声吵醒。

    他翻了个身，从枕头底下摸出手机看了一眼，六条未读消息，全来自苏念念。

    “起床了吗？”

    “安槐？”

    “你要是七点半之前没回消息我就去砸你的门。”

    “我出发了。”

    “到你家门口了。”

    “最后通牒。”

    最后一条消息的发送时间是两分钟前。安槐看了看时间，七点零三分，他披上外套走到门口开门。

    苏念念站在门外，扎着低马尾，穿着运动服和跑鞋，手里拎着两个纸袋。

    “你再不开门我就真砸了。”

    “老大早。”

    “你怎么头发都没梳？”苏念念嫌弃地看了他一眼，“眼屎都没擦。”

    安槐抹了一下眼角。

    “老大有什么事？”

    苏念念把一个纸袋塞到他手里。

    “我妈做的肉包子，热的，先吃，吃完跟我去练功。”

    安槐低头看了一眼纸袋，肉包子的香味扑面而来。

    “去哪练？”

    “城东的青石坡，我爸以前带我去过，那地方灵气浓度比学校高一些，周末人少，正好练功。”

    安槐回屋换了衣服，边走边啃包子。

    苏念念走在前面，步伐轻快，嘴里叽叽喳喳说着格斗课的事。

    “昨天格斗课有个二班的女生挺厉害的，叫韩青，就是药池那次碰到的那个，她跟我打了一场，平手。”

    “韩青淬体四重，能跟你打平手说明你的近身格斗进步了。”

    “进步了也只是平手，下次我要赢她。”

    两人沿着城区的街道一路往东。

    青石坡在青岚城东郊，是一片半天然的灵脉露头区域。

    地面布满青灰色的岩石，灵气从岩石缝隙间丝丝缕缕地渗出来，浓度确实比城区内高了不少。

    到地方的时候，太阳刚升到树梢。

    苏念念甩了甩手臂，开始热身，安槐站在旁边扫了一圈四周，确认没有其他人之后，也开始拉伸。

    “你先练，我在旁边看着。”安槐说。

    “你不练？”

    “等你练完我再练，有人的时候我不太想暴露功法细节。”

    苏念念歪头看他。

    “你在我面前还有什么好藏的？”

    安槐笑了笑。

    “我练功的时候比较专注，万一附近有情况，需要有人放哨。”
content_en:
At seven o'clock on Saturday morning, An Huai was woken up by a rapid knock on the door.

He turned over and took out his phone from under the pillow and took a look. There were six unread messages, all from Su Niannian.

"Are you up?"

"An Huai?"

"If you don't reply before seven-thirty, I'm going to break down your door."

"I'm off."

"At your door."

"Ultimatum."

The last message was sent two minutes ago.An Huai looked at the time. It was 7:03. He put on his coat and walked to the door to open the door.

Su Niannian stood outside the door, wearing a low ponytail, sportswear and running shoes, and holding two paper bags in her hands.

"If you don't open the door, I'll really smash it."

"Good morning, boss."

"Why didn't you comb your hair?" Su Niannian gave him a disgusted look, "You didn't even wipe your eyes."

An Huai wiped the corners of his eyes.

"What's the matter, boss?"

Su Niannian stuffed a paper bag into his hand.

"The meat buns made by my mother are hot. Eat them first. After that, follow me to practice."

An Huai lowered his head and glanced at the paper bag, and the smell of meat buns hit his face.

"Where to practice?"

"My dad took me to Qingshi Slope in the east of the city. The spiritual energy concentration there is higher than that of the school. There are fewer people on weekends, so it's a good time to practice martial arts."

An Huai went back to the house, changed clothes, and ate buns while walking.

Su Niannian walked in front, walking briskly, chattering about fighting lessons.

"Yesterday in the fighting class, there was a girl from class two who was very good. Her name is Han Qing. She is the same girl that I met in Yaochi. She fought with me and we were tied."

"Han Qing is at the fourth level of body tempering. Being able to tie with you means that your close combat has improved."

"It's just a tie even if we improve. I will beat her next time."

The two of them walked eastward along the streets of the city.

Qingshi Slope is a semi-natural spiritual vein outcrop area on the eastern outskirts of Qinglan City.

The ground is covered with blue-gray rocks, and spiritual energy seeps out from the cracks in the rocks. The concentration is indeed much higher than in the city.

When we arrived, the sun had just risen above the treetops.

Su Niannian shook her arms and started to warm up. An Huai stood nearby and scanned the area. After confirming that there was no one else, he also started stretching.

"You practice first, I'll watch from the side." An Huai said.

"You don't practice?"

"I'll practice after you finish practicing. I don't want to reveal the details of the technique when there are people around."

Su Niannian tilted her head and looked at him.

"What else do you have to hide from me?"

An Huai smiled.

"I'm more focused when I'm practicing. If there's something going on nearby, someone needs to be on guard."
